mayor.mayor_p1: I am excited to present our Smart Adama Guidebook, which demonstrates our commitment to building a smarter, sustainable, and inclusive urban environment. As we confront rapid population growth, environmental issues, public safety concerns, and rising service demands, it is clear that innovative solutions are needed. This guidebook details our strategic plan for implementing advanced technologies, promoting innovation, and leveraging data-driven initiatives to address these challenges.
mayor.mayor_p2: Through our smart Adama initiatives, we strive to improve residents' quality of life by developing resilient public services, ensuring safety, and creating a competitive city that benefits both residents and local businesses.
mayor.mayor_quote: "Our vision is centered around the aspiration to elevate the standard of living for every individual in our community."
mayor.mayor_p3: By uniting our efforts, we can collaboratively create an innovative hub that supports entrepreneurs, improves the overall business climate, and fosters a vibrant, inclusive, and livable city that is prepared to meet the demands and opportunities of the future.
mayor.mayor_p4: Furthermore, I would like to take this opportunity to extend my heartfelt gratitude to all our stakeholders. Your invaluable contributions and collaborative spirit have played a pivotal role in the ongoing transformation of Adama. It is through your dedication and hard work that we are witnessing significant advancements, and we wholeheartedly acknowledge the positive impact your efforts will undoubtedly have on shaping the future of our beloved city. Together, we are paving the way for a brighter tomorrow.

mayor.fw_ent_desc: Empowers local digital economic growth by providing infrastructure and support to tech startups and local businesses.
mayor.fw_food_desc: Utilizes IoT sensors, automated irrigation, and data-driven supply chains for sustainable smart agriculture.

faqs.study_1_a: Study Mode lets you read the Smart Adama content, track your progress, and ask the assistant about the material you are viewing.
faqs.study_2_a: Chapter quizzes are used to assess your understanding. Your progress and achievement state are updated from the learning system.
faqs.study_3_q: Why might my progress not appear immediately?
faqs.study_3_a: Progress is tied to the learning actions recorded by the application. If a change does not appear, refresh the page and confirm that the action was completed successfully.
faqs.dash_1_q: What does my learning progress show?
faqs.dash_1_a: The dashboard summarizes your completed chapters, overall progress, quiz performance, learning streak, and achievements.
faqs.dash_2_a: Badges are connected to learning milestones such as completing chapters, maintaining consistency, and performing well in assessments.
faqs.dash_3_a: Use the Continue Learning section on the dashboard to return to the next chapter in your learning journey.
faqs.prof_1_q: How do I change my profile picture?
faqs.prof_1_a: Open your profile settings and use the profile picture control to upload a new image.
faqs.prof_2_a: Appearance is controlled through the application-wide theme system, so the selected theme is shared across Smart Adama pages.
faqs.prof_3_q: Where can I update my account information?
faqs.prof_3_a: Use the Personal Information section of your profile page to update your account details.
faqs.gen_1_a: Open the Dashboard to see your progress, or go to Study to begin learning from the Smart Adama content.
faqs.gen_2_a: The assistant receives the current route and your conversation history so it can provide more relevant answers within the application.
faqs.gen_3_q: Where can I change my account settings?
faqs.gen_3_a: Open your Profile page from the navigation bar to manage your profile, security, preferences, and appearance.
